thread:
tess: Quick alert  restore dry-run failed on a few DB snapshots: DecryptAccessDenied when calling KMS Decrypt for snapshots under s3://db-snapshots-prod/2026-04-01.

raj: which SSE shows up in head-object?

tess: head-object shows ServerSideEncryption: AES256 for some files but CloudTrail PutObject shows SSE:aws:kms with a different KMS key ARN (vendor account).

kms-monitor: flagged anomaly: cross-account KMS usage detected for snapshot objects. Added ticket INC-900.

vendor-eng: we pushed an uploader change during onboarding that sets SSEKMSKeyId from env var. Looks like vendor env pointed to their account key by mistake.

oncall-sre: containment: block vendor principal on bucket with a temporary bucket policy deny for PutObject/CopyObject, and pause scheduled restores.

raj: run an inventory: list objects where SSE != "aws:kms" OR SSEKMSKeyId not in allowed set. I can script and output CSV.

tess: plan: 1) temp deny vendor uploads, 2) inventory + CSV, 3) re-encrypt repair prefix using our CMK (aws s3 cp --metadata-directive REPLACE --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ourkey), 4) smoke test restores, 5) postmortem & vendor SLA update.

oncall-sre: applied deny (commit d4e9f3). Paused restores.

vendor-eng: we'll rotate env on our side, revoke vendor key grants, and sign an attestation.

kms-monitor: recommend long-term: bucket policy enforcement for SSEKMSKeyId whitelist, CloudTrail metric and alarm on PutObject/CopyObject with disallowed KMS keys, and KMS grant TTLs.

raj: CSV posted: 18 affected objects. Starting re-encrypt sample of 3 now.

tess: assigned actions and timeline in INC-900. ETA for containment + first repair run: 90 mins. Thanks. :lock:
